title: Not durable over time
text:
Not durable over time. I have owned this for less than a year and the bottom is now loose. It's held on by two rivets. Not ideal.

I squirted a little WD-40 on it and the next day it would not stay up on its own. I got a spring clip to hold it up. That worked.

"Bulldog Clamp (10 Pack) Spring Grip Garage Closet Wall Organizer for Brooms, Mops, Rakes, Etc." will hold it up.
